A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MedSynapse-V and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary sections. Removed analyses can be distinguished reliably from relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v3 reports original medical benchmark results, component ablations, efficiency measurements, training diagnostics, and qualitative analyses in the main text and supplement.

after.justification: v4 retains original benchmark results in Table 1, ablations in Table 2, and supplementary modality comparisons, design studies, and case analyses.

M1.justification: The MQPM, CCR, and IMT stages, architectures, objectives, memory injection procedure, and encoder-free inference remain unchanged in Sections 2 and 5.

E1.justification: Training data, the seven main evaluation benchmarks, and supplementary OmniMedVQA modality coverage are unchanged. Additional datasets mentioned in related work are not newly evaluated.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains all 15 baselines, including MMedExpert-R1, Coconut, MCOUT-Multi, and IVT-LR. The per-modality and efficiency comparisons also retain their comparator sets; added references do not introduce evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The reported data splits, sample counts, evaluation metrics, training budgets, and decoding procedures remain unchanged. Removing training-monitoring analyses does not establish a revised experimental protocol.

E4.justification: v4 removes v3 Section 6/Figure 10, covering warmup convergence, reward decomposition, gradient stability, policy/KL behavior, and distillation alignment. It also removes Section 8.4/Figure 12's comparison of memory representations across training stages. These eliminate two substantive mechanism analyses; the other ablations and relocated failure cases remain.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five independent runs and mean reporting in Table 1 and Section 5, with the same seed-related information in Table 3. No confidence-interval or significance-testing practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–10 retain their numerical results, including Table 1's 61.4% encoder-assisted and 59.6% IMT averages. Removed diagnostic findings include v3's reported JSD decrease from approximately 0.42 to 0.035, output agreement increase from 72% to approximately 97%, and stagewise clustering evolution. Changes are confined to these supplementary diagnostic outcomes.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and objectives in Equations 1–8 are unchanged. The confidence definition accompanying the relocated failure analysis is also retained; no theorem, proof, or derivation is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same novelty, diagnostic-accuracy, generalization, and inference-efficiency claims.

C2.justification: The deleted analyses remove specific interpretations that causal rewards stabilize gradients, warmup leaves insufficiently separated representations, and IMT preserves the refined memory topology. The main mechanism discussion and limitations concerning rare modalities, multiple lesions, and subtle features remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Deleting v3 Figure 10(c) removes its explicit gradient-norm clipping threshold of 1.0. This is a loss of documented implementation information, not evidence that the setting changed. Architecture details, Table 3, hardware, training time, and prompt templates are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: The bibliography retains the original 160 works and adds 55. The rewritten related-work section substantially broadens coverage to visual skill and concept-graph memory, EEG reconstruction, efficient token and prompt use, RAG reliability, agent safety, and additional medical imaging research. The central novelty claim remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Related-work prose is rewritten and condensed, and Additional Qualitative Results moves from Section 9 to Section 6. Subsequent supplementary sections are reorganized and renumbered. The main narrative and method exposition remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 Figures 10 and 12 are removed. Existing qualitative, failure-analysis, intervention, and prompt figures are relocated or renumbered, and Tables 9–10 appear together in v4. Retained graphics and table designs remain unchanged, so the presentation revision consists mainly of removals and rearrangement.

improvement.justification: v4 broadens literature coverage but removes detailed training-monitoring and stagewise memory-evolution evidence without replacement. This reduces support for convergence, stability, and distillation interpretations while retaining the associated core claims. The unchanged benchmark results, extensive remaining ablations, and preserved failure analysis limit the overall decline.
